dedupe_keys.name: pgfd 10 millisecond english grid frequency at five solar sites

description: The PGFD team publishes grid-frequency measurements from five solar sites in England during April 2023. Its Figshare collection groups five site-specific deposits, each with thirty daily Parquet files and timestamps at ten-millisecond intervals. The article abstract reports about 1.3 billion records across the full collection. Each component states CC BY 4.0 and public access is free; the collection itself has no separate licence field. Coverage is the five monitored sites for one month, not every British feeder or a longer seasonal period. The traces can calibrate frequency-dynamics and event-detection studies alongside power-network-flow and resilience simulations in a context such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that 10-millisecond recordings at solar sites do not directly reveal system-wide cause, inertia or power imbalance. Clock synchronization and missing intervals need checking before comparing sites. All five component DOIs are retained as access links. Own metadata and manifests were read without downloading the large daily files or fitting a frequency model.
